LeeSin.escape: Look for an engage before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back, but check whether Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is still available. He can use both mobility abilities together to escape, so don't rush in if only one is down. When his mobility abilities are down, close the distance with Ekko E Phase Dive and block his escape route with Ekko W Parallel Convergence.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so back off if you encounter him in the jungle and buy time with lane and objective advantages. In the mid to late game, Ekko's damage, Ekko W Parallel Convergence's shield, and Ekko R Chronobreak's healing all become stronger, so take advantage of that timing.
LeeSin.teamfight: After Lee Sin's engage and crowd control are used and an ally starts the fight, enter the back line with Ekko E Phase Dive. Before going in, choose a safe spot to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak. Keep your distance so you don't collide with allies knocked back by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage, and if needed, deal damage and disengage with Ekko R Chronobreak.

Lissandra.build: Consider Mercury's Treads first to counter Lissandra's root and stun. Lissandra deals magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor.
Lissandra.fight: Trade right after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. If she has also used Lissandra E Glacial Path, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence along her escape route first, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then close in with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to the minions to avoid the piercing path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard. Use Ekko Q Timewinder to clear the wave, but save enough mana to use your combo in a fight.
Lissandra.escape: The moment after Lissandra uses Lissandra E Glacial Path is your chance to close the distance with Ekko E Phase Dive. It's a good time to engage if Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are also down, since the risk of being caught is lower. To prevent Lissandra E Glacial Path from being recast, prepare in advance to land the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence as the claw travels.
Lissandra.phase: Ekko's clear speed is not especially fast early, so look for ganking opportunities using Ekko W Parallel Convergence. In the mid to late game, as ability power builds, Ekko's damage, shield, and healing all become stronger.
Lissandra.teamfight: Enter the back line after Lissandra's engage and crowd control have been used and an ally starts the fight. In particular, check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path has been fully spent, and choose a safe spot to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak before going in.
Lissandra.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on Lissandra's path, then throw Ekko Q Timewinder and use Ekko E Phase Dive as it returns to go in and land an empowered attack. Aim for the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and an attack. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, spread out your damage until the stasis from her self-cast ends.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces minions after hitting one, so don't stand in a line with your minions. Lissandra W Ring of Frost's root and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb's stun can put you in danger before you can use Ekko R Chronobreak, so don't rush in while both abilities are available.

Leblanc.watch: When the LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice mark is on you, back away so you don’t get hit by another ability. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Ekko E Phase Dive or Ekko R Chronobreak to get out of range before the root takes hold. Don’t use abilities on the clone from LeBlanc P Mirror Image; follow the one that’s actually attacking.
Leblanc.fight: While the LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice mark remains, don’t move forward. Trade after LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or is used. As Ekko Q Timewinder returns, close in with Ekko E Phase Dive and land both hits and an empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. Use the movement speed it grants to get away.
Leblanc.laning: If LeBlanc pushes the lane and disappears from vision, alert your team immediately. Before pushing forward in a side lane, secure river vision. To start a fight, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on LeBlanc’s escape route, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then go in with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Leblanc.combo: After LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or is used, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on her escape route. Then slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder and use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the zone and look for a stun. As Ekko Q Timewinder returns, land an empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, and use Ekko R Chronobreak if needed.
Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc uses W Distortion is a chance to close the gap, but keep track of where she can return to while the return is available. Once the return expires or is used, and the threat of being rooted by LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains has passed, close in with Ekko E Phase Dive and look for a stun with Ekko W Parallel Convergence.
Leblanc.phase: The available information isn’t enough to say which champion is stronger early. Apply pressure in a side lane unless a teamfight is the right play, and alert your team if LeBlanc disappears from vision.
Leblanc.teamfight: Don’t go in first. Wait for LeBlanc’s engage and crowd control to be used and for your allies to start the fight, then dive the back line. Before going in, keep a safe return position in mind for Ekko R Chronobreak, and place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on LeBlanc’s escape route in advance. If a clone from LeBlanc P Mirror Image appears, use abilities on the one that’s actually attacking.
Leblanc.build: The starting purchase can’t be determined from the information alone. All of LeBlanc’s ability damage is magic, so build magic resistance rather than armor. When stacking additional resistances, also consider a spell shield to block LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice combos and movement speed to get out of telegraphed areas.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding roots you, you’re likely to get hit by the follow-up, so bait it out and dodge it first. Watch for the slow where Lux E Lucent Singularity is placed, and move sideways when the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark appears. If a Lux ability applies the Lux P Illumination mark, create distance so you don’t get hit by an empowered attack.
Lux.build: The available information doesn’t specify the exact first purchase. Prioritize magic resistance over armor. Lux’s main damage is magic, and Ekko’s magic damage is effective against Lux’s low magic resistance.
Lux.fight: Right after baiting out and dodging Lux Q Light Binding is your chance to go in. Close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive and combine both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder with an empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. Use the movement speed it grants to get away and finish the trade.
Lux.laning: Lux Q Light Binding roots up to the first two enemies it hits, so don’t stand in a straight line with an ally. Approach from a brush or the side to create an angle to go in after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Don’t spend all your mana using Ekko Q Timewinder to clear waves; save some for fights.
Lux.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on Lux’s escape route, then slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder. If needed, deal damage and disengage with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Lux.escape: Go in right after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive and block her escape route with Ekko W Parallel Convergence. If things get dangerous, return to your previous position with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Lux.phase: Ekko’s jungle clear isn’t especially fast early, so look for gank opportunities using the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence. The available information isn’t enough to assess Lux’s relative strength at different stages of the game.
Lux.teamfight: Go in on Lux’s back line after the opponent’s engage and crowd control have been used and your allies start the fight. Approach from a different direction than your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity doesn’t stop you all together. Before going in, keep a safe return position in mind for Ekko R Chronobreak, and use the opening after Lux Q Light Binding is used to close in with Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko E Phase Dive.

Lillia.watch: If Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed hits you, you become a target for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so dodge them even if you have plenty of health. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! begin casting, move sideways to avoid its center. If you’re caught by her ultimate, move to a safe place during the drowsy period before you fall asleep.
Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first to defend against Lillia’s main damage.
Lillia.fight: Close the gap when Lillia misses an ability and has no movement speed stacks. Use both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and the empowered attack from Ekko E Phase Dive to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed you gain to get away.
Lillia.laning: Use Ekko Q Timewinder to clear waves, but don’t spam it and run short on mana for fights. When ganking, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on Lillia’s escape route, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then go in with Ekko E Phase Dive. If you don’t know where Lillia is, don’t pass through jungle entrances or narrow river paths without caution.
Lillia.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in advance in the direction Lillia will move. Slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then as it returns, use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the zone and chain a stun into an empowered attack. If needed, use Ekko R Chronobreak with the return position you planned in mind.
Lillia.escape: Right after you make Lillia use W Watch Out! Eep! is a chance to close the gap. If you’re caught by Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, retreat to safety before you fall asleep instead of continuing the engage.
Lillia.phase: Ekko’s jungle clear isn’t especially fast early, but Ekko W Parallel Convergence can create gank opportunities with its stun.
Lillia.teamfight: Have Ekko W Parallel Convergence ready to catch Lillia when she comes in from the side. Rather than diving in first, wait for the opponent’s engage and crowd control to be used and for your allies to start the fight, then go to the back line. Before going in, decide on a safe return position for Ekko R Chronobreak.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to a nearby enemy, so move away from that minion. If you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, dodge outside the portals and engage after the silence ends. Malzahar R Nether Grasp’s suppression can’t be removed by Ekko R Chronobreak or a shield, so don’t enter an area without vision alone.
Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance first to defend against Malzahar’s main damage. If you need to prepare for Malzahar R Nether Grasp, buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. Avoid choices that only add a lot of health, since Malzahar deals damage based on a percentage of your maximum health.
Malzahar.fight: When Malzahar P Void Shift is active, strip it first with Ekko Q Timewinder before dealing damage. Dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void and, when there are no Voidlings, close in with Ekko E Phase Dive and aim to trigger your passive on the third hit. Use the movement speed it grants to get away.
Malzahar.laning: Push and pressure early to limit the time Malzahar has to build up Malzahar W Void Swarm. Move away from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions to avoid the effect transferring to you. If Malzahar pushes the lane, call your jungler, strip Malzahar P Void Shift, then go in together.
Malzahar.combo: First strip Malzahar P Void Shift with Ekko Q Timewinder. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on Malzahar’s escape route in advance, slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the zone and look for a stun. Follow with an empowered attack to trigger the third hit of your passive, and use Ekko R Chronobreak when needed.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no mobility ability, so the chance to go in comes right after you dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void and strip Malzahar P Void Shift. If Voidlings are present, clear them first with Ekko Q Timewinder, then close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive once they’re gone. When Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, don’t go in alone without allied crowd control support.
Malzahar.phase: Early, pressure the lane with Ekko or look for a play with your jungler so Malzahar has no time to build up. In the mid game, you can start fights often once Ekko R Chronobreak is available. Malzahar gets stronger over time and the matchup becomes unfavorable, so in the late game avoid going in alone and getting suppressed.
Malzahar.teamfight: Go to the back line after your allies start the fight and Malzahar’s crowd control has been used. If Voidlings are already present, clear them with Ekko Q Timewinder, then strip Malzahar P Void Shift and look for a stun with Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Before going in, choose a safe return position for Ekko R Chronobreak.

MasterYi.watch: Master Yi cannot be targeted during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so time your abilities for right after he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows have no effect, so don’t rely on Ekko Q Timewinder’s slow to create distance. While Master Yi E Wuju Style is active, his basic attacks include true damage, so don’t stay in an extended close-range fight.
MasterYi.build: Resistance does not reduce the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, so build health as well. Attack speed reduction helps lower both his basic attack damage and the cooldown reduction on Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
MasterYi.fight: After throwing Ekko Q Timewinder, use Ekko E Phase Dive to close in as it returns, landing both hits and an empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. Use the movement speed it grants to disengage after a short trade, and when Master Yi W Meditate begins, interrupt it with the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence that you prepared in advance.
MasterYi.laning: In lane, use Ekko Q Timewinder to clear waves, but don’t spam it and run short on mana for fights. When ganking, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead along Master Yi’s path, then follow up with Ekko Q Timewinder and Ekko E Phase Dive. If there’s no opening to start a team fight, pressure a side lane and use your mobility to get out.
MasterYi.combo: Follow up with an empowered attack to land the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. Master Yi can’t be targeted during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so time your next hit for when he lands. Use Ekko R Chronobreak to return if needed.
MasterYi.escape: Right after Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is your chance to close in on him or catch him out. Approach with Ekko E Phase Dive and look for a stun with Ekko W Parallel Convergence placed in advance. Before going in, set up a safe place to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, so take early objectives and disrupt his path to scaling. He also gets stronger as the game goes on, so don’t delay taking an early lead.
MasterYi.teamfight: Prevent allies from getting caught alone so Master Yi can’t pick up takedowns, and group up to layer crowd control on his first entry. Ekko shouldn’t dive in first; wait until Master Yi Q Alpha Strike lands and other engage abilities have been used, then look for a stun with Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Choose a return spot for Ekko R Chronobreak before going in, and use it for damage and escape when needed.

MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so you can’t dodge it while you’re in range. If Wukong Q Crushing Blow hits you, your armor is reduced, so avoid extended trades once you are close together. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster appears, don’t use abilities on the clone left in place; watch which direction the real one will move.
MonkeyKing.build: Buy armor first to prepare for Wukong’s main damage, including Wukong Q Crushing Blow and R Cyclone. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Wukong E Nimbus Strike, but the available information gives no reason to prioritize magic resistance. Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only stack health.
MonkeyKing.fight: The longer you fight Wukong up close, the more armor and healing he gains, so deal damage briefly and back off. While Wukong W Warrior Trickster is on cooldown, block his escape route with Ekko W Parallel Convergence, trigger your passive with Ekko Q Timewinder and Ekko E Phase Dive, then use the movement speed to create distance.
MonkeyKing.laning: Early on, use Ekko’s magic damage to retaliate aggressively against Wukong’s low magic resistance. Look for an opening outside Wukong E Nimbus Strike’s range, though, and keep the trade short once you are close together. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead along Wukong’s path, slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then go in.
MonkeyKing.combo: After confirming Wukong W Warrior Trickster is on cooldown, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead along Wukong’s path. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive as it returns to enter the zone and chain the stun into an empowered attack. Also land both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder to trigger the third hit of your passive.
MonkeyKing.escape: Don’t go in just because Wukong W Warrior Trickster is on cooldown; check whether he can still use Wukong E Nimbus Strike. In particular, use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter during the window before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes off cooldown and after Wukong R Cyclone’s knock-up has also been spent. Block his escape route with Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and use Ekko R Chronobreak to get out if things get dangerous.
MonkeyKing.phase: Ekko can look for short trades early thanks to Wukong’s low magic resistance, but Wukong has the advantage in an extended fight. If there’s no opening to start a team fight, pressure a side lane.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: Before going in, set up a safe return spot for Ekko R Chronobreak. Right after Wukong R Cyclone has been fully spent, look for a fight or an objective.

Mel.watch: Mel W Rebuttal can reflect Ekko Q Timewinder, so hold Q when she looks ready to use W. If you’re hit in the center of Mel E Solar Snare, you’ll be rooted, so sidestep it. If repeated hits have built up Overwhelm, back off even if you still have health. Mel R Golden Eclipse can reach you from far away while Overwhelm stacks remain, so after a fight, wait somewhere safe until they wear off.
Mel.build: Mel’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Also keep an eye on your remaining health and shields in case Mel P Searing Brilliance executes you.
Mel.fight: When Mel W Rebuttal is on cooldown, look for both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder. As it returns, use Ekko E Phase Dive to close in and trigger an empowered attack and Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. Mel has no mobility spell, so once you close the gap, trade and use Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance’s movement speed to get out.
Mel.laning: Push and pressure the lane from the start so Mel has no time to stack up Mel R Golden Eclipse. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in advance along the escape route behind Mel, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then go in with Ekko E Phase Dive. Don’t spam Q on the wave and leave yourself without mana to fight.
Mel.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead along Mel’s escape route, then throw Ekko Q Timewinder once Mel W Rebuttal is on cooldown. If you need to finish her off, account for the missing-health-based attack damage from Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Use Ekko R Chronobreak with your return position in mind.
Mel.escape: Your chance to go in comes when you sidestep the root from Mel E Solar Snare or Mel W Rebuttal is on cooldown. Close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive and look for a stun with Ekko W Parallel Convergence placed in advance. If you risk being rooted by Mel E Solar Snare, save E for that moment.
Mel.phase: Pressure Mel early, before she gets her core items, to slow her growth. Ekko can take fights more often after getting Ekko R Chronobreak and also becomes stronger in the mid and late game, but Mel R Golden Eclipse’s growth stacks are permanent, so don’t drag the game out without purpose. If there’s no opening to start a team fight, use Ekko Q Timewinder to push and pressure a side lane.
Mel.teamfight: After the enemy’s engage and crowd control are used and your team starts the fight, use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the back line. Before going in, keep a safe return spot for Ekko R Chronobreak in mind, and don’t rush Ekko Q Timewinder if Mel W Rebuttal is still available. If you leave with Overwhelm stacks, Mel R Golden Eclipse can hit you, so stay somewhere safe until the stacks wear off.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can easily root people standing behind a target after hitting that target, so don’t stand on top of your allies. If Neeko approaches while disguised, the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may not be visible, so spread out as soon as someone you suspect is Neeko gets close. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; watch the real Neeko’s position.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Neeko’s main damage. If you’re likely to be rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then killed by Neeko R Pop Blossom, prioritize tenacity and buy Mercury’s Treads.
Neeko.fight: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, close in with Ekko E Phase Dive and force a trade. Land both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder, add an empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed to get out.
Neeko.laning: Don’t force an engage while Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is available; once it’s used, close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive. Leave areas where Neeko Q Blooming Burst has landed, and don’t spam Ekko Q Timewinder on the wave and run out of mana for a fight.
Neeko.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead along Neeko’s escape route, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the zone and stun her. Follow up with the empowered attack from Ekko E Phase Dive and both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. Ekko W Parallel Convergence has a windup, so don’t cast it after you’ve already closed in.
Neeko.escape: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used is your chance to go in with Ekko E Phase Dive. Check where you’ll return with Ekko R Chronobreak before you engage.
Neeko.teamfight: Don’t dive in first; enter the back line after Neeko’s engage and crowd control have been used. If a disguised Neeko gets close, spread out from your allies so you aren’t all hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom, and don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter. Choose a safe return spot for Ekko R Chronobreak before going in, and place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in advance along Neeko’s path.

Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once, keep your distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. Naafiri E Eviscerate revives her pack, so even after clearing it, don’t assume her damage is reduced while E is still available. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available, don’t roam alone, and back off immediately after an ally dies so you don’t get picked off in succession.
Naafiri.build: Naafiri’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor and health. Magic resistance won’t help against her main damage. If a long duel makes the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate hard to deal with, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances.
Naafiri.fight: While bleeding from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, don’t use Ekko E Phase Dive to engage; keep your distance. Right after Naafiri E Eviscerate, use Ekko Q Timewinder to clear her pack and look for a chance to counterattack. Land both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and follow with Ekko E Phase Dive’s empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then escape with the movement speed.
Naafiri.laning: Use Ekko Q Timewinder to clear her pack and the wave, but don’t spam it and run out of mana for a fight. Before engaging, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence along Naafiri’s path, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then enter the zone with Ekko E Phase Dive. If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you first, stop trading until you have avoided the second hit.
Naafiri.combo: Use both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and an attack to land the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use Ekko R Chronobreak if needed.
Naafiri.escape: If only Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers is on cooldown, don’t rush to chase; Naafiri E Eviscerate and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit are still available. Your chance to engage comes after she has used several mobility abilities, especially before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back. Then close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive and place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of time to block her escape route.
Naafiri.phase: Ekko’s early clear isn’t especially fast, but Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun can create gank opportunities. In the mid game, watch especially for Naafiri’s roams, maintain broad vision, and avoid getting picked off alone. After learning Ekko R Chronobreak, Ekko can start fights more often and grows stronger in the mid to late game. In a late-game head-on teamfight, group with your team and use area damage to clear Naafiri’s pack.
Naafiri.teamfight: Don’t engage first as Ekko. Wait until Naafiri’s engage and crowd control are used and an ally starts the fight, then enter the back line. Before going in, set a safe return point with Ekko R Chronobreak. Right after Naafiri E Eviscerate revives her pack, clear it with Ekko Q Timewinder. If an ally dies, back off immediately because Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit can pick you off in succession.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage from farther away, so avoid it by keeping minions or your allied front line between you and her. Avoid Nidalee W Bushwhack too, so you don’t get marked and become vulnerable to her empowered cougar abilities and chase. If you’re marked, save Ekko W Parallel Convergence for when Nidalee W Pounce comes in.
Nidalee.build: Prioritize magic resistance in your first defensive purchase. All of Nidalee’s listed damage abilities deal magic damage, so magic resistance is more effective than armor.
Nidalee.fight: Close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive right after Nidalee W Pounce. Land both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder, follow with an empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then escape with the movement speed you gain.
Nidalee.laning: Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack around the river and jungle entrances. Check for traps with a Control Ward or Ekko Q Timewinder before entering. When ganking, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence along the enemy’s escape route, slow them with Ekko Q Timewinder, then engage with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Nidalee.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence along Nidalee’s path, then throw Ekko Q Timewinder. When needed, use Ekko R Chronobreak to return to the point you had in mind beforehand.
Nidalee.phase: Ekko’s early jungle clear isn’t especially fast, so avoid Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack while looking for a chance to fight. In the mid to late game, as you build ability power, Ekko’s damage, Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s shield, and Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing all grow stronger.
Nidalee.teamfight: After an ally starts the fight and the enemy’s engage ability is used, watch Nidalee’s position as she steps up to throw a spear, then enter the back line. Nidalee is fragile and Nidalee W Pounce is her only mobility ability, so catch her with Ekko W Parallel Convergence after she uses it. Before going in, set a safe return point with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Nidalee.escape: The moment after Nidalee uses Nidalee W Pounce is your chance to go in with Ekko E Phase Dive. Aim to stun her with Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and choose a safe return position with Ekko R Chronobreak before you go in.

Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up. When you see it, dodge sideways or move to a spot Nunu has already passed instead of running straight ahead. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, its root comes later, so leave the area immediately. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, see if you can interrupt it with Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun; if that’s difficult, leave its area before the slow intensifies.
Nunu.build: Get Morellonomicon early to reduce the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Most of their damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Also consider tenacity if the snowball’s crowd control is a problem.
Nunu.laning: Nunu & Willump may return soon after an initial gank, so don’t push the lane and stand forward for long. When following up on a gank, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence along Nunu & Willump’s escape route, slow them with Ekko Q Timewinder, then go in with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Nunu.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence along Nunu & Willump’s path. Then slow them with Ekko Q Timewinder and, as Q returns, enter the zone with Ekko E Phase Dive to connect the stun and an empowered attack. If you may need Ekko R Chronobreak, keep your return point in mind before engaging.
Nunu.escape: Your chance to engage with Ekko E Phase Dive comes after dodging the knockup from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and the threat of a root from E Snowball Barrage has passed. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance, so you can keep them in place if Ekko W Parallel Convergence also hits. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, use E Phase Dive to get out immediately before the root lands.
Nunu.phase: In the mid to late game, Ekko’s damage, Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s shield, and Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing all grow stronger, so engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used.
Nunu.teamfight: Rather than engaging first, wait until Nunu & Willump’s engage and crowd control are used and an ally starts the fight, then enter the back line. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, look for a chance to interrupt it by stunning them with a pre-placed Ekko W Parallel Convergence; if that’s difficult, leave its area. Before going in, set a safe return point with Ekko R Chronobreak, and use it to heal and escape when needed.
Nunu.fight: Dodge the crowd control from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage, then close in with Ekko E Phase Dive. Trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and the empowered attack from E, then use the movement speed you gain to get away. Nunu & Willump can heal with Nunu & Willump Q Consume, so check whether you can finish the fight before committing.

Orianna.watch: Watch where Orianna Q Command: Attack places the ball, and leave the area around it because Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. Don’t stay close to Orianna for a prolonged fight because of the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and the empowered basic attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.build: Ekko’s magic damage is effective against Orianna, so prioritize ability power. Orianna’s main damage is magic, so choose magic resistance if you build resistances.
Orianna.fight: Trade right after Orianna Q Command: Attack sends the ball away from her. Slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, close in with Ekko E Phase Dive to land the third hit of your passive, then escape once you gain movement speed.
Orianna.laning: Look for Orianna’s weaker early game, but avoid extended attack trades and trade with abilities instead. After she sends out the ball, check its position and apply brief pressure while it is away from her.
Orianna.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence along Orianna’s escape route, then slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder. In a short trade where Ekko W Parallel Convergence is difficult to land, close in with Ekko E Phase Dive as Ekko Q Timewinder returns.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no mobility ability, so check the ball’s position and Orianna R Command: Shockwave before engaging. If the ball is close and you risk being pulled in, or Orianna W Command: Dissonance slows and catches you, plan your return point in advance so you can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Orianna.phase: Early on, you can pressure Orianna’s low defensive stats, but avoid trades where she lands empowered attacks repeatedly. After learning Ekko R Chronobreak, Ekko can start fights more often. In the mid to late game, as you build ability power, his damage, shield, and healing all grow stronger.
Orianna.teamfight: Check the ball’s position before Orianna herself, and avoid places where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. After an ally starts the fight and Orianna uses her defensive abilities, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of time and use Ekko E Phase Dive to reach the back line. Before going in, set a safe return point with Ekko R Chronobreak.

Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root you when she has the river element, so move out of range if she approaches with it. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes and stuns when it hits a wall, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and avoid riverbanks and narrow passages. If she disappears with the brush element, move into an ally’s vision.
Qiyana.build: Qiyana P Royal Privilege, Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, and E Audacity deal primarily physical damage, so build armor first. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health. If you’re at high risk of being locked down by Qiyana’s crowd control and unable to use Ekko R Chronobreak, choose Mercury’s Treads.
Qiyana.fight: Trade when Qiyana has used W Terrashape and E Audacity and is still nearby. Before Qiyana E Audacity comes back, close in with Ekko E Phase Dive and block her escape route with Ekko W Parallel Convergence, placed in advance. If you trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, use the movement speed you gain to get away.
Qiyana.laning: Fight Qiyana in an open area away from walls and the river. When health is below half, create distance first if Qiyana approaches with the rock element. If she’s still nearby just after using all her abilities, trade with Ekko Q Timewinder and E Phase Dive. Ekko Q Timewinder can clear waves, but don’t spam it and run out of mana for fights.
Qiyana.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in Qiyana’s escape path in advance, then slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder. If you time a basic attack as Ekko Q Timewinder returns, you can quickly trigger the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t rush in when only Qiyana W Terrashape is on cooldown; she can still escape with E Audacity. Go in with Ekko E Phase Dive before Qiyana E Audacity comes back, especially right after she has also used W Terrashape. While Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal with the river element threatens you, first move out of root range.
Qiyana.phase: Early on, don’t give Qiyana an advantage through forced fights. In the mid game, when she is strongest, build armor and stay with your allies, while keeping away from terrain to avoid Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. Qiyana gets relatively weaker as the game goes on, while Ekko is strong in the mid-to-late game, so look for fights after her engage ability is down.
Qiyana.teamfight: Go into the backline after abilities like Qiyana E Audacity and her crowd control are down and your allies have started the fight. Before engaging, choose a safe spot to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak, and keep away from walls and the river because of Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in Qiyana’s path in advance to set up a stun, and return with Ekko R Chronobreak if things get dangerous.

Poppy.fight: Close the distance after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and W Steadfast Presence has ended. Slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then combine both its outgoing and return hits with the empowered basic attack from Ekko E Phase Dive to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, and use the movement speed you gain to get away. Even if Poppy looks low on health, her armor and magic resistance increase at that threshold, so check that you have enough damage to finish her before going in.
Poppy.laning: Trade in open space without standing with your back to a wall or narrow passage to avoid the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge’s wall impact. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador falls, step on it first to prevent her from gaining a shield. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in Poppy’s path in advance, and save enough mana for fights when using Ekko Q Timewinder.
Poppy.combo: Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended and E Heroic Charge is down, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in her path in advance. Slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then enter the field with Ekko E Phase Dive to stun her and land an empowered basic attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. When needed, return to a position you chose in advance with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use E Heroic Charge is an opportunity to close the distance, but if Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait for it to end before dashing in with Ekko E Phase Dive and R Chronobreak. Before engaging, set up a safe return position with Ekko R Chronobreak. Don’t delay your return too long, since Poppy’s crowd control or heavy damage may prevent you from using R.
Poppy.phase: The available information isn’t enough to determine which of the two champions is stronger early. In the jungle, Ekko’s early clear speed isn’t especially fast, but he can look for ganks with the stun from W Parallel Convergence.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage from Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper's Verdict. If the enemy team has heavy crowd control, choose Mercury's Treads to reduce the chance that Ekko gets locked down and can’t use R Chronobreak. Don’t spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.teamfight: Don't engage first. Wait until the enemy's engage tools and crowd control, including Poppy E Heroic Charge and W Steadfast Presence, are down, then dive into the enemy backline. Before engaging, choose a safe return position with Ekko R Chronobreak and place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on the enemy's path. If Poppy R Keeper's Verdict starts charging, avoid its path and judge when to return.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t engage with Ekko E Phase Dive; wait for it to end or close the distance on foot. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it pushes you into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you on the first strike, leave the remaining area immediately. If Poppy R Keeper's Verdict is charging, move sideways out of its path.

Rammus.watch: When Rammus rolls in with Q Powerball, keep minions between you and him, and stay out of Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range. Rammus R Soaring Slam after Q Powerball can hit a wider area than expected, so move well clear and leave the landing area immediately.
Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. If you must attack while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, percentage penetration is more valuable than flat penetration.
Rammus.fight: Stop basic attacking and back away when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, then deal your damage after it ends. Look for an opportunity outside Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range. When you engage, use both the outgoing and return hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and the empowered basic attack from Ekko E Phase Dive to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance.
Rammus.laning: Keep a minion wave between you and Rammus before you see Q Powerball to block his approach. When engaging, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in Rammus’s path in advance, slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then enter the field with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Rammus.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in Rammus’s direction of travel in advance, then throw Ekko Q Timewinder. Choose a return point with Ekko R Chronobreak before engaging so you can use it when needed.
Rammus.phase: The available information makes it difficult to judge which champion has the early advantage. If it’s hard to start a teamfight, clear waves with Ekko Q Timewinder and pressure a side lane.
Rammus.teamfight: Watch for engages with Rammus Q Powerball and R Soaring Slam, and for Rammus E Frenzying Taunt; don’t dive in first. Go into the backline after the enemy’s engage abilities and crowd control are down and your allies have started the fight. Before engaging, set up a safe return point with Ekko R Chronobreak, and attack a different target while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active.
Rammus.escape: At this point, close the distance with Ekko E Phase Dive and place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead. If you’re taunted, use Ekko E Phase Dive or Ekko R Chronobreak as soon as the taunt ends to get away.

Ryze.watch: If you’re marked by Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root and Ryze Q Overload is empowered, so dodge Ryze E Spell Flux first. If you’re hit by the mark, move away from your allies and keep your distance until it disappears.
Ryze.build: Ryze’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Movement speed is also important for getting out of the spots he targets.
Ryze.fight: Close the distance with Ekko E Phase Dive when you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux or after Ryze W Rune Prison is down. Use both the outbound and returning hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and the empowered basic attack from Ekko E Phase Dive to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed you gain to get away.
Ryze.laning: Ryze lacks mana and damage early, so pressure him before he completes his items to slow his growth. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in Ryze’s escape path in advance, slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then engage.
Ryze.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in the direction Ryze is likely to move. Then slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, enter the field with Ekko E Phase Dive to stun him, and trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with an empowered basic attack. If needed, deal damage and escape with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Ryze.escape: If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux or Ryze W Rune Prison is down, close in with Ekko E Phase Dive while the risk of being rooted is lower.
Ryze.phase: Pressure Ryze early while he lacks mana and damage. Don’t stay in a prolonged fight at a distance where his mark can keep refreshing.
Ryze.teamfight: Go into the backline to reach Ryze after the enemy’s engage abilities and crowd control are down and your allies have started the fight. If you see Ryze R Realm Warp being cast, you can interrupt Ryze himself with the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence.

Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator leaps from brush and builds Ferocity, so avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. At full Ferocity, Rengar E Bola Strike roots, while empowered Rengar W Battle Roar removes crowd control. Watch for Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt, and don’t roam alone while injured.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar’s main damage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Rengar W Battle Roar, and its effectiveness is reduced while Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt lowers your armor.
Rengar.laning: When Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside brush and use a Control Ward to reveal it. After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, engage with Ekko E Phase Dive. Use Ekko Q Timewinder to clear waves, but don’t spam it and run short on mana for a fight.
Rengar.escape: After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, engage with Ekko E Phase Dive. If Rengar W Battle Roar is also down, you have an opportunity to catch him with Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Before engaging, set a safe return location for Ekko R Chronobreak.
Rengar.phase: Early on, watch for Rengar’s brush leaps and Ferocity, and avoid risky trades. In the mid and late game, Ekko’s damage, Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s shield, and Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing all grow stronger, so look for fights then.
Rengar.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on Rengar’s engage path. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then, once Rengar E Bola Strike misses and Rengar W Battle Roar is down, use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the field and stun him. Land the empowered attack as Ekko Q Timewinder returns to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, and use Ekko R Chronobreak if needed.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar’s Ferocity bar is empty. Once you confirm Rengar W Battle Roar is down, use Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun and follow up with damage. Hit with the empowered attack from Ekko E Phase Dive as Ekko Q Timewinder returns to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance.
Rengar.teamfight: Hold position near your allied front line and within vision, and wait for Rengar to engage. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down, use the Ekko W Parallel Convergence you placed ahead to try to stun him. Dive into the enemy backline after Rengar's engage tools and crowd control are down and your team starts the fight. Before engaging, choose Ekko R Chronobreak's return position.

RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai uses Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow to go underground, move toward open space and use Ekko E Phase Dive to dodge the knock-up as she surfaces. Also watch out for the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and the max-health-based damage from Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If you’re hit by Rek'Sai’s ranged attack while she is Burrowed, stay near allies while Rek'Sai R Void Rush can still reach you.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against Rek'Sai’s main damage. Resistances don’t work against the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, but Rek'Sai R Void Rush also scales with your max health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. Consider lowering her attack speed to counter Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker’s basic attacks and attack speed.
RekSai.fight: Use Ekko E Phase Dive to dodge the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then close the distance. Combine Ekko Q Timewinder’s hits on the way out and back with an empowered basic attack from Ekko E Phase Dive to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed to disengage. When Rek'Sai goes underground to heal, keep dealing damage instead of letting her create distance.
RekSai.laning: Early on, don’t push the lane recklessly or walk alone through areas without vision. Step on visible Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel tunnel entrances near lane to destroy them and limit her gank routes and escape paths. When ganking, cast Ekko W Parallel Convergence in the enemy’s escape path first, slow them with Ekko Q Timewinder, then engage with Ekko E Phase Dive.
RekSai.combo: Slow with Ekko Q Timewinder, then, as it returns, use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the field and stun, followed by an empowered basic attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. You may need Ekko R Chronobreak, so keep your return location in mind before engaging.
RekSai.escape: Dodge the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow and engage during the window after Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and Rek'Sai R Void Rush are down. If only one of her mobility tools is down, she can escape with the other, so cast Ekko W Parallel Convergence in her escape path ahead of time. Close the distance with Ekko E Phase Dive, and use Ekko R Chronobreak to return if needed.
RekSai.phase: Early on, focus on not giving Rek'Sai kills while watching for her attempts to build an advantage through ganks. As the game goes on, Ekko’s damage, Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s shield, and Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing all grow stronger, so look for fights in the mid and late game.
RekSai.teamfight: Go into the backline after Rek'Sai’s engage and knock-up are down and your team has started the fight. Before engaging, choose a safe return location for Ekko R Chronobreak and cast Ekko W Parallel Convergence in Rek'Sai’s path. While Rek'Sai R Void Rush makes her untargetable, prepare Ekko W Parallel Convergence at her landing point.

Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault knocks you up, and Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns, so watch their tells and sidestep. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, get out of range before the second. If attacks from Sejuani and her melee allies build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks, immediately create distance.
Sejuani.build: Sejuani’s heavy crowd control can kill you before you can cast Ekko R Chronobreak, so choose Mercury's Treads. Build magic resistance first against Sejuani’s main damage.
Sejuani.fight: While Sejuani P Fury of the North’s Frost Armor is active, slows don’t work and her defensive stats are high, so deal damage first to create an opening for the armor to break. Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, close in with Ekko E Phase Dive and trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with Ekko Q Timewinder’s hits on the way out and back and an empowered basic attack. Use the movement speed after triggering it to create distance.
Sejuani.combo: Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, cast Ekko W Parallel Convergence in her path of movement first. Slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the field and stun, followed by an empowered basic attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. If needed, use Ekko R Chronobreak to return to the location you had in mind.
Sejuani.escape: The window to engage is immediately after you bait Sejuani into using Q Arctic Assault. If you also dodge Sejuani R Glacial Prison before going in, you can reduce the risk of being locked down and unable to cast Ekko R Chronobreak. Before engaging, choose a safe return location for Ekko R Chronobreak.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, Sejuani’s kill and damage stats are low, so pursue jungle control and objectives to delay her item timings. In the mid and late game, as Ekko builds ability power, his damage, Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s shield, and Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing all grow stronger.
Sejuani.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Wait until Sejuani’s engage tools and crowd control, including Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison, are down. Enter the backline after your team starts the fight, and choose a safe Ekko R Chronobreak return location before going in. Create distance if Sejuani E Permafrost stacks build up.
Sejuani.laning: Use Ekko Q Timewinder to clear waves, but don't spam it and run out of mana for fights. When Sejuani is nearby, watch whether Sejuani E Permafrost stacks are building on you while you are near enemy melee champions. When starting a fight, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of time on the enemy's escape route.

Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first, accounting for the damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Also build health to help avoid the low-health threshold where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison’s damage rises sharply. Keep in mind that magic resistance cannot block the physical damage from Shaco Q Deceive.
Shaco.fight: The moment Shaco appears from Shaco Q Deceive is an opportunity to engage, so focus your damage on him immediately with allies. Combine Ekko Q Timewinder’s hits on the way out and back with an empowered basic attack from Ekko E Phase Dive to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. Disengage with the movement speed it grants, and use Ekko R Chronobreak to return if things get dangerous.
Shaco.laning: Early on, maintain vision at your team’s jungle entrances to guard against Shaco’s ganks and invades. Assume brush without vision contains Shaco W Jack In The Box, and don’t enter without checking. When targeting Shaco after Shaco Q Deceive is down, cast Ekko W Parallel Convergence in his escape path first, slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then engage with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Shaco.combo: Once Shaco Q Deceive is down, cast Ekko W Parallel Convergence in Shaco’s path first. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then, as it returns, use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the field and follow up the stun with an empowered basic attack. Trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with Ekko Q Timewinder’s hits on the way out and back and an empowered basic attack, and use Ekko R Chronobreak if needed.
Shaco.escape: Engage just after Shaco appears from Shaco Q Deceive, while he can’t immediately escape with the same ability. Check for nearby Shaco W Jack In The Box first, then cast Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of time and engage with Ekko E Phase Dive. Before going in, keep a safe return location for Ekko R Chronobreak in mind.
Shaco.phase: Early on, watch out for Shaco trying to gain an advantage through ganks and invades. Don’t give him kills, and secure vision and objectives. If you buy time, Shaco’s ability to fight alone falls off later, so choose favorable fights.
Shaco.teamfight: Ekko should focus damage on Shaco with allies after Shaco engages and uses his crowd control, rather than diving in first. Don’t miss the moment Shaco appears from Shaco Q Deceive; cast Ekko W Parallel Convergence in his path ahead of time to catch him. Avoid wasting damage on Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone by identifying the real one from health bar reactions. When the clone dies, move away to avoid the explosion and boxes.
Shaco.watch: Watch out for Shaco W Jack In The Box fear in bushes without vision and around objectives; check them first with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens. If Shaco gets behind you with Shaco Q Deceive, his empowered attack is dangerous, so if you think he’s nearby, keep your back to a wall or face your allies. When low on health, watch out for Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison and don’t take routes without vision. If you kill Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone, retreat immediately to avoid the explosion and boxes.

Skarner.laning: Clear waves with Ekko Q Timewinder, but don't spam it and run out of mana for a fight. Avoid standing with a wall behind you and Skarner E Ixtal's Impact's engage path, and place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Skarner's approach. If there's no opening to start a team fight, use Ekko's wave clear and mobility to pressure a side lane.
Skarner.combo: Once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Skarner's path. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then time Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the zone as Q returns and stun him. Trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with an empowered attack. If you may need Ekko R Chronobreak, set up a safe return position before engaging.
Skarner.escape: Right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, go in with Ekko E Phase Dive and use the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence to stop Skarner from sticking to you again. If you get stunned against a wall, Skarner E Ixtal's Impact may come back soon, so retreat farther. You can't escape Skarner R Impale with a mobility spell once it catches you, so create distance with Ekko E Phase Dive or Ekko R Chronobreak before being suppressed.
Skarner.phase: Ekko's early jungle clear isn't especially fast, but the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence can create gank opportunities. Seek early jungle control and objectives to limit the time Skarner has to build tank items.
Skarner.teamfight: Enter the enemy backline after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale are down and your team has started the fight. Before going in, choose a safe position to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak, and place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in advance to set up your angle. Skarner R Impale can pull you through terrain, so don't stand against the edge of the Dragon or Baron pit.
Skarner.build: First decide whether you need to remove Skarner R Impale’s suppression; if so, build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. If you’re building resistances, consider magic resistance first to counter the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.fight: The moment after you bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your chance to close the distance. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of time along Skarner’s path, slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the sphere and aim for a stun. Land both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and an empowered attack to trigger the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed to get out.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain and can stun you against a wall, so don't stand with your back to one. You can't escape Skarner R Impale's suppression with Ekko E Phase Dive or Ekko R Chronobreak, so create distance before you get in range. Stay outside melee range to avoid taking consecutive empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.

Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is between you and Syndra, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push and stun you, so get out of the sphere's line. Syndra R Unleashed Power is also dangerous where several Syndra Q Dark Spheres are placed, so reposition. When low on health, watch out for its execute.
Syndra.build: Buy boots early to get enough movement speed to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak on foot. Build magic resistance against her main magic damage, but also consider health to withstand the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power. Choose Mercury's Treads if there's a lot of crowd control.
Syndra.fight: Close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down. Land both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and the empowered attack from Ekko E Phase Dive to trigger the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed to get away.
Syndra.laning: Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak are ground-targeted or thrown abilities, so keep moving to dodge them and don't stand in a sphere's line. When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of her escape path, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then engage. Don't spam Ekko Q Timewinder and run out of mana for a fight.
Syndra.combo: When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of her escape path. Slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then enter the zone with Ekko E Phase Dive and stun her. Follow up with a basic attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. Use Ekko R Chronobreak if needed, but choose your return position before engaging.
Syndra.escape: Syndra has no mobility, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak is a long-cooldown self-peel tool, so the moment after she uses it is your window to engage. Close in with Ekko E Phase Dive and block her escape route with Ekko W Parallel Convergence. If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is still available, don't engage along a sphere's line.
Syndra.phase: The available information isn't enough to determine which side is stronger early. If Syndra's ability effects change, account for the empowered effect or range and adjust your distance.
Syndra.teamfight: Don't engage first. Wait until Syndra E Scatter the Weak and the enemy team's other crowd control are down and your team has started the fight, then enter the enemy backline. Avoid areas with many Syndra Q Dark Spheres, where Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous. Before engaging, choose a safe position to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak, and use it before crowd control or burst damage can interrupt you.

Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can't change direction, so don't approach in a straight line; sidestep it. If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is laid down, Taliyah W Seismic Shove can push you across the rocks and stun you, so move away from the field immediately.
Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Taliyah's main abilities, Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Choose Mercury's Treads if crowd control could keep you from using Ekko R Chronobreak before you die.
Taliyah.fight: If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is laid down, don't dash across it with Ekko E Phase Dive; go around it or approach on foot. Once you can get close, land both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and the empowered attack from Ekko E Phase Dive to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed to get away.
Taliyah.laning: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on Taliyah's escape path first, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then go in with Ekko E Phase Dive. If Taliyah disappears, be mindful of her movement speed near walls and her ability to use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to affect another lane; retreat in advance.
Taliyah.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Taliyah's path, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then enter the zone with Ekko E Phase Dive and stun her. Follow up with an empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, and use Ekko R Chronobreak if needed.
Taliyah.escape: Engage while both Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall are down. In particular, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on her escape path and close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back.
Taliyah.phase: Ekko's early clear isn't especially fast, but the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence can set up ganks.
Taliyah.teamfight: Enter the enemy backline after Taliyah's engage and crowd control are down and your team has started the fight. Before engaging, choose a safe position to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak, and choose an approach that doesn't dash across Taliyah E Unraveled Earth.

Shyvana.watch: Watch out for the slow and maximum-health-based damage from Shyvana E Molten Burst, and don't stay in range of Shyvana Q Emberstrike for long. Shyvana is unstoppable while flying with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, so place Ekko W Parallel Convergence to land at her landing point.
Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Add armor to account for her physical damage from basic attacks. Don't rely on building only health, since Shyvana Q Emberstrike deals true damage and damage based on maximum health.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury is empty, and don't start a fight if it's full. Slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, close in with Ekko E Phase Dive to trigger the third hit of your passive, then use the movement speed you gain to create distance.
Shyvana.laning: Don't give Shyvana room to stick to you and use Shyvana Q Emberstrike and Shyvana W Inferno Aegis for long. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Shyvana's path and slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder to set up a hit.
Shyvana.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Shyvana's intended path. Slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then time Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the zone as Q returns and stun her. Follow up with an empowered attack to try to land the third hit of your passive. If needed, use Ekko R Chronobreak to return to the position you chose before engaging.
Shyvana.escape: Don't try to interrupt Shyvana R Dragon's Descent with crowd control; catch her after she lands with Ekko W Parallel Convergence. After she uses Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, look for a chance to attack by closing the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive. Use your passive's movement speed or Ekko R Chronobreak when you need to get away.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, pressure Shyvana while she has few stacks to limit her growth from camps and objectives. However, Shyvana P Scalemail also gains permanent stacks, so this matchup becomes less favorable as the game goes on.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so the path of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, and Shyvana E Molten Burst don't overlap on multiple allies. After Shyvana lands, catch her with Ekko W Parallel Convergence and counterattack once her transformation ends and she returns to human form. Ekko should engage after an ally starts the fight rather than diving in first; choose your return position with Ekko R Chronobreak before going in.

Sylas.watch: If Sylas E Abscond / Abduct hits with the second chain, it knocks you up and lets him follow with more attacks, so use Ekko E Phase Dive to dodge the chains instead of the first dash. Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes late at the intersection, so move out immediately even if you were only grazed by the first hit. Sylas W Kingslayer provides greater healing at lower health, so don’t delay the finish. Sylas R Hijack can steal Ekko’s ultimate, so don’t let him get in range to steal it.
Sylas.build: Sylas deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor. Prioritizing movement speed to leave telegraphed attack zones is also effective.
Sylas.fight: Dodge the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, then engage after both Sylas W Kingslayer and E Abscond / Abduct are on cooldown. Proc Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with the outward and returning hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and the empowered attack from Ekko E Phase Dive, then use the movement speed to get out. If Sylas is low, use Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s passive to finish him with an attack.
Sylas.laning: Use Ekko Q Timewinder to clear waves, but don’t spam it and run out of mana for a fight. After dodging the chains from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, check that both of his mobility abilities are on cooldown before trading.
Sylas.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence first along Sylas’s approach or escape path. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the field, trigger the stun, and land an empowered attack. Time the returning hit of Q to proc Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, and use Ekko R Chronobreak to deal damage and disengage if needed.
Sylas.escape: Don’t go in just because Sylas used the first dash of E Abscond / Abduct; dodge the second chain with Ekko E Phase Dive. Your opening is when Sylas W Kingslayer and E Abscond / Abduct are both on cooldown and Ekko can still engage. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of time to make it harder for Sylas to escape during that window.
Sylas.phase: If it’s difficult to start a team fight, use Q to clear waves and E to damage structures while applying side lane pressure.
Sylas.teamfight: Engage after Sylas’s engage and crowd control are on cooldown and an ally has started the fight, rather than going in first. Precast Ekko W Parallel Convergence along Sylas’s approach with E Abscond / Abduct and stun him to create a chance to kill him before he heals with W Kingslayer. Before engaging, identify a safe position to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak.

Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you on the first strike, move out of the returning blades’ path to prevent stacks of Talon P Blade’s End. Don’t chase recklessly while Talon R Shadow Assault is available, since he can escape with stealth.
Talon.build: Talon deals physical damage, so build armor first. If he has lethality, build health too instead of relying on a small amount of armor. Talon’s high magic resistance blunts Ekko’s magic damage, so add magic penetration when increasing attack damage.
Talon.fight: Avoid Talon’s strong early trades, then retaliate right after he uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Hit both passes of Ekko Q Timewinder and add the empowered attack from Ekko E Phase Dive to trigger the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed to get out.
Talon.laning: Talon can roam over terrain, so share his position and secure vision along jungle routes. When it’s safe to push the lane, pressure him into returning to farm.
Talon.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence first along Talon’s direction of travel or escape route. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the field, stun him, and land an empowered attack. Time it with the returning hit of Ekko Q Timewinder to proc Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, and use Ekko R Chronobreak when needed.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy is a chance to close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive. Dodge the returning blades from Talon W Rake, then place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of time to block his approach. Continue your counterattack once you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault is also on cooldown.
Talon.phase: Talon’s influence falls off later, so safely buy time while looking for side lane pressure and opportunities to fight.
Talon.teamfight: Instead of diving in first, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence along Talon’s route to your backline and group with your allies to respond. After an ally starts the fight and Talon’s engage is on cooldown, slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder and use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the field and look for a stun. Before engaging, keep a safe return position in mind for Ekko R Chronobreak.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge, so if you’re trapped inside, move within the cage instead of running into the edge. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where and when it will land, so watch the ground marker and sidestep. When health drops below half, leave the range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which grows stronger based on missing health.
Veigar.build: Veigar E Event Horizon can leave you dead before you can use Ekko R Chronobreak, so consider Mercury’s Treads first. The resistance to withstand damage from Veigar Q Baleful Strike, W Dark Matter, and R Primordial Burst is magic resistance, not armor.
Veigar.fight: After Veigar E Event Horizon is on cooldown, close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive. Throw Ekko Q Timewinder, then time Ekko E Phase Dive’s empowered attack with Q’s return to quickly proc Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. Keep moving during trades instead of standing still, so you can dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Veigar Q Baleful Strike pierces only the first two units it hits, so stand behind minions to avoid the poke. When ganking, wait until Veigar E Event Horizon is on cooldown, then place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of time along Veigar’s escape route.
Veigar.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence first along Veigar’s escape route. Then slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the field and stun him, and proc Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with an empowered attack. Use Ekko R Chronobreak when needed, keeping your return position in mind before engaging.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility, so go in when Veigar E Event Horizon is on cooldown. Close in with Ekko E Phase Dive and place Ekko W Parallel Convergence along his escape route to keep him from getting out. If trapped in the cage, don’t rush into the edge; move within it, then use Ekko E Phase Dive or Ekko R Chronobreak when you leave.
Veigar.phase: Ekko can start fights more often after learning Ekko R Chronobreak and once his later ability cooldowns begin to shrink, and he is strong in the mid and late game. Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stacks are permanent, so it gets harder to kill him from the same angle as the game goes on.
Veigar.teamfight: Don't go in first. Wait for Veigar E Event Horizon and the enemy's other crowd control to be used, and for your allies to start the fight, then dive into the enemy backline. Before going in, choose a safe position to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak. Before objective fights, check Veigar's position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with W Pick a Card, stay out of his attack range because one empowered attack will stun you. Stand behind minions to reduce poke damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
TwistedFate.build: Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s stun can put you in danger before you can use Ekko R Chronobreak, so consider Mercury’s Treads first for your boots. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Twisted Fate’s damage, so choose magic resistance if you’re building resistances.
TwistedFate.fight: Engage with Ekko E Phase Dive right after Twisted Fate uses his gold card from W Pick a Card. Overlap both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder with the empowered attack from Ekko E Phase Dive to proc Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed to get out.
TwistedFate.laning: Reduce poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards by standing behind minions, and use Ekko Q Timewinder while keeping enough mana for a fight. Keep your distance while Twisted Fate holds a gold card; when he uses it, look for a chance to go in with Ekko E Phase Dive.
TwistedFate.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence first along Twisted Fate’s escape route. Then slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the field and stun him, and proc Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with an empowered attack. Use Ekko R Chronobreak to deal damage or return when needed.
TwistedFate.escape: The window to go in with Ekko E Phase Dive opens right after Twisted Fate’s gold card from W Pick a Card is used.
TwistedFate.phase: In the mid and late game, Ekko’s damage, the shield from Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak all become stronger, so use side lane pressure and opportunities to fight.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Don't go in first. Wait for crowd control such as Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card to be used, then dive into the enemy backline. Before going in, set up a safe return position with Ekko R Chronobreak. If Twisted Fate R Destiny is visible and in range, look for a chance to interrupt his movement with Ekko W Parallel Convergence.

Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so dodge to the side when you see him charging. Set up Ekko W Parallel Convergence in advance to create a chance to interrupt the charge. When low on health, fall back so you are not targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker.
Viego.build: Build armor first to deal with the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If a duel drags on because of the healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances. Choose Mercury's Treads if the enemy team has a lot of strong crowd control.
Viego.fight: Avoid small skirmishes you are unlikely to win so Viego cannot get a takedown. When Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego R Heartbreaker are down, especially before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back, use Ekko E Phase Dive to close the gap and deal brief damage. Escape with the movement speed from the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance.
Viego.laning: If you see Viego E Harrowed Path on terrain, avoid that route or place a Control Ward there, and do not push the lane in that direction. When starting a fight, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on Viego's escape route first, then slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder.
Viego.combo: Set up Ekko W Parallel Convergence in the direction Viego is heading to give yourself time to prepare. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then enter the sphere with Ekko E Phase Dive to stun him and land an empowered attack. If your attack lines up with Ekko Q Timewinder returning, you can quickly trigger the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance.
Viego.escape: Do not go in just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down; check whether Viego R Heartbreaker is still available too. Once Viego's mobility and stun are down, and before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back, engage with Ekko E Phase Dive and block his escape route with Ekko W Parallel Convergence.
Viego.phase: Ekko's jungle clear is not especially fast early on, so do not give Viego a takedown in a risky small skirmish.
Viego.teamfight: Enter the enemy backline after Viego's engage and crowd control are down and your team has started the fight. Before engaging, choose a safe position to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak. If an ally falls in front of Viego, either leave that spot or bind Viego with Ekko W Parallel Convergence to prevent him from possessing them.

Vex.watch: When the Doom mark from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is visible, dashing in with Ekko E Phase Dive can be interrupted by fear. Wait until Vex has just used Doom on the wave or to poke. If hit by Vex R Shadow Surge, move toward your allies so you can take Vex's dash together.
Vex.build: The available information is not enough to determine a specific first purchase. If you need defense, build magic resistance against Vex's magic damage, and consider movement speed and tenacity as well. When building offense, ability power increases Ekko's damage as well as the shield from W Parallel Convergence and the healing from R Chronobreak.
Vex.fight: Start a trade after Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's Doom and the shield from Vex W Personal Space are both down. Line up Ekko E Phase Dive's empowered attack with Ekko Q Timewinder's round trip to trigger the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then escape with the movement speed you gain. If your dash applies the Gloom mark, do not stay within Vex's attack range for long.
Vex.laning: Clear the wave with Ekko Q Timewinder, but do not use it so much that you run out of mana for a fight. Right after Vex uses Doom on the wave, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on her escape route first and look for an engage. If you need to dodge Vex E Looming Darkness at close range, take a short step to the side instead of backing far away.
Vex.combo: Once you confirm Vex's Doom is down, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of her in the direction she is moving. Slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then enter the sphere with Ekko E Phase Dive to stun her and land an empowered attack. If you also line it up with Ekko Q Timewinder returning, you can quickly trigger the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance.
Vex.escape: The moment after the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is used is your window to engage with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Vex.phase: Use Ekko W Parallel Convergence early on, but do not engage first with Ekko E Phase Dive while Vex's Doom is ready. Ekko is strongest in the mid to late game as he builds ability power, so pressure a side lane if the situation is not suitable for starting a team fight.
Vex.teamfight: Before going in, set up a safe return position with Ekko R Chronobreak, and use it for damage and escape when needed. Low-health allies should move outside Vex’s range first so Vex R Shadow Surge can’t reset with an initial takedown.

Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals much more damage when charged, so back away or move to the side when you see her charging. Vi R Cease and Desist pursues its target to the end and applies a stun and knock-up, so do not leave vision alone while Vi has R available.
Vi.build: Build armor first because Vi Q Vault Breaker, W Denting Blows, and E Relentless Force deal primarily physical damage. Vi W Denting Blows shreds armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase health. Choose Mercury's Treads if the enemy team has a lot of strong crowd control.
Vi.fight: Vi W Denting Blows gains strength through consecutive attacks, so avoid fighting for long; deal damage briefly, then create distance. Right after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker, close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive and block Vi's next path with Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Once Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance triggers, escape with the movement speed it grants.
Vi.laning: If Vi comes toward you right after using a skill on a minion, she may be engaging with Vi P Blast Shield active, so trade after the shield is removed. When engaging, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on Vi's escape route first, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then go in with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Vi.combo: After dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on Vi's path. Then slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, and when the sphere is ready, enter with Ekko E Phase Dive to stun her.
