Look to trigger the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with Ekko Q Timewinder's round trip and Ekko E Phase Dive's empowered attack.
Vi.escape: Your window to engage with Ekko E Phase Dive is right after you bait out and dodge Vi Q Vault Breaker. While Vi is charging in with Vi R Cease and Desist, do not try to stop her movement; once she lands and the knock-up ends, create distance with Ekko E Phase Dive or Ekko R Chronobreak.
Vi.phase: Ekko's early jungle clear is not especially fast, so look for brief skirmishes while dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker. As you build ability power, the shield from Ekko W Parallel Convergence and the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak also grow, making Ekko strongest in the mid to late game.
Vi.teamfight: Do not dive in first while Vi Q Vault Breaker and R Cease and Desist are available. Enter the enemy backline after your team starts the fight and Vi's engage and crowd control are down. Before engaging, set up a safe position to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak. Vi R Cease and Desist cannot be dodged with Flash, so stay within range of your allies' protective abilities.

Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede increases his movement speed and stuns with his first attack, so watch for him to approach right after activating the stance. During the Awakened effect of Udyr E Blazing Stampede, immobilizing effects do not work, so save Ekko W Parallel Convergence's stun for after it ends. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so do not stay close for long.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr. However, armor cannot block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and one type of resistance cannot block both damage types from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. If the enemy team has a lot of strong crowd control, choose Mercury's Treads so Ekko can move and use Ekko R Chronobreak.
Udyr.fight: After the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is removed, slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder and press the attack with Ekko E Phase Dive's empowered attack. Create distance with the movement speed gained when Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance triggers. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede stuns you once, use the window when it cannot immediately stun the same target again to counterattack or escape.
Udyr.laning: Udyr reveals himself when ganking from the jungle, so keep vision on key routes and jungle entrances, and do not move up the lane when he is unseen. When ganking as Ekko, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on the enemy's escape route first, slow them with Ekko Q Timewinder, then go in with Ekko E Phase Dive. If the situation is not suitable for starting a team fight, clear the wave with Ekko Q Timewinder and pressure a side lane.
Udyr.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on the path the opponent is likely to take, then throw Ekko Q Timewinder. When Ekko Q Timewinder returns, enter the sphere with Ekko E Phase Dive to stun them and land an empowered attack, aiming for the third hit of Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. Before engaging, choose a safe return position, then use Ekko R Chronobreak to return when needed.
Udyr.escape: Udyr E Blazing Stampede is his only form of mobility, so close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive immediately after baiting it out. Catch him with Ekko W Parallel Convergence's stun after the Awakened effect of Udyr E Blazing Stampede ends. When backing off, simply walking makes it hard to get away from Udyr, so save Ekko E Phase Dive or Ekko R Chronobreak.
Udyr.phase: Ekko's early jungle clear is not especially fast, so focus on ganking with the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence. In the mid to late game, as Ekko builds ability power, his damage, the shield from Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak all become stronger.
Udyr.teamfight: Do not try to force down Udyr first when he has the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle and defensive items; target the weaker opponents behind him. Go in after Udyr's engage and stun are down and your team has started the fight. Before engaging, choose a safe position to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak, then attack the enemy backline.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray is a straight-line skillshot, so don’t stand in line with the wave; sidestep it. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave immediately instead of continuing to trade inside it to avoid the stun. Watch out for the AoE damage from Viktor R Arcane Storm as well.
Viktor.build: Viktor deals magic damage, so build magic resistance. You can avoid the stun from Viktor W Gravity Field by leaving its area, so prioritize movement speed. If the enemy team has a lot of strong crowd control, choose Mercury’s Treads.
Viktor.fight: After dodging Viktor W Gravity Field, close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive. Hit with Ekko Q Timewinder on both the outbound and return paths, then add an empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. Use the movement speed you gain to get out.
Viktor.laning: Pressure Viktor early before Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks up. Avoid standing in line with the wave to reduce poke from Viktor E Hextech Ray. Use Ekko Q Timewinder while keeping enough mana to trade.
Viktor.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence on Viktor’s escape route first. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the sphere, stun him, and land an empowered attack. Keep moving so you don’t stay inside Viktor W Gravity Field, and use Ekko R Chronobreak when needed.
Viktor.escape: Engage when Viktor W Gravity Field is down or when you can leave its area. Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so close in with Ekko E Phase Dive and block his escape route with Ekko W Parallel Convergence.
Viktor.phase: The early game, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution has stacked, is your chance to pressure him. However, Viktor’s growth is permanent, so reassess the same trade once his upgrades have stacked.
Viktor.teamfight: Approach Viktor after the enemy’s engage and crowd control are down and your team has started the fight. Before going in, keep a safe return position in mind for Ekko R Chronobreak, and don’t continue fighting inside Viktor W Gravity Field. Viktor has no dash, so look to land the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence when you get on top of him.

Vladimir.build: Vladimir’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the duel runs long, get anti-heal to counter his healing. Against a Vladimir who is stacking health, consider Liandry’s Torment for its max-health-based damage.
Vladimir.fight: While Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available, don’t rely on Ekko W Parallel Convergence as your decisive stun. First bait out the pool with Ekko Q Timewinder, then engage with Ekko E Phase Dive when it ends. You can trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance quickly by timing Ekko Q Timewinder’s hits in both directions with an empowered attack from E.
Vladimir.laning: When ganking, first place Ekko W Parallel Convergence along the escape route, slow with Ekko Q Timewinder, then go in with Ekko E Phase Dive. Vladimir slows while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, giving you a chance to close the gap.
Vladimir.combo: First bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool, then place Ekko W Parallel Convergence where he will emerge. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the sphere, stun him, and land an empowered attack. If you land E’s empowered attack as Ekko Q Timewinder returns, you can quickly get the third hit for Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance.
Vladimir.escape: Right after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your chance to close in with Ekko E Phase Dive and land Ekko W Parallel Convergence. If you’re afflicted by Vladimir R Hemoplague, step back and engage after the effect ends. If the fight gets dangerous, use Ekko R Chronobreak to return to your previous position and take advantage of its healing and damage immunity.
Vladimir.phase: Vladimir also gets harder to deal with as he scales, so don’t miss your chance to gain an early lead.
Vladimir.teamfight: Don’t group up and let several teammates get hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague; if you’re afflicted, join the fight after the effect ends. Ekko should enter the backline after the enemy’s engage and crowd control are down and his team has started the fight. Before going in, keep a safe return position in mind for Ekko R Chronobreak, and look to land the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence when Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals him and also increases his movement speed when empowered, so keep your distance if he approaches with an empowered Q. When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. Vladimir R Hemoplague increases the damage you take, so re-engage after the effect ends.

Xerath.build: Xerath’s attacks deal magic damage, so choose magic resistance if you’re building resistance. Xerath E Shocking Orb’s stun is especially dangerous, so choose Mercury’s Treads if you need to prepare for hard crowd control.
Xerath.fight: Trade by closing the gap right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Throw Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive as it returns to close in and trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with the hits in both directions and an empowered attack.
Xerath.laning: Farm while avoiding the heavy damage from Xerath’s long range. Xerath uses a lot of mana in lane, so when he starts running low, push the wave with Ekko Q Timewinder and call your jungler. When ganking, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Xerath’s escape route.
Xerath.combo: First place Ekko W Parallel Convergence where Xerath is headed, then slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder. Follow with Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the sphere, stun him, and trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with an empowered attack. If you may need Ekko R Chronobreak, decide where you’ll return before engaging.
Xerath.escape: Right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to go in. Xerath has no mobility, so close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive and catch him with Ekko W Parallel Convergence, placed ahead of his escape route.
Xerath.phase: Early on, keep Xerath’s range in mind, avoid his heavy damage, and farm. Apply pressure in a side lane unless you’re in a position to start a teamfight.
Xerath.teamfight: Enter the backline where Xerath is after the enemy’s engage and crowd control are down and your team has started the fight. Before going in, choose a safe return position for Ekko R Chronobreak and place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Xerath’s escape route. When you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge or engage on Xerath while he can’t move.
Xerath.watch: If you’re stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb, you can take follow-up attacks too, so dodge this ability first. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and move to the side. Watch out for the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction as well. When you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge immediately or engage on Xerath.

Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and its fear triggers, so use Ekko E Phase Dive to create distance and fight after the fear triggers. If you’re caught by Warwick R Infinite Duress, you can’t use Ekko R Chronobreak while suppressed, so you need to dodge the leap first.
Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. If the physical damage from his basic attacks is a problem, build armor too. If the duel runs long, apply anti-heal with Executioner’s Calling.
Warwick.fight: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, hold your burst and back off.
Warwick.laning: If your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position and increases Warwick’s movement and attack speed, so recall even if you have to give up some farm. Use Ekko Q Timewinder to clear the wave, but don’t spend so much mana that you run out for a fight.
Warwick.combo: First place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in Warwick’s path, slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the sphere and stun him. Follow with an empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, and use Ekko R Chronobreak to deal damage while disengaging if needed.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down; look for an opening before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up. After Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear has triggered, placing Ekko W Parallel Convergence in advance and going in with Ekko E Phase Dive makes it easier to prevent Warwick from escaping.
Warwick.phase: Early on, if you give Warwick a kill, Warwick W Blood Hunt can keep forcing you to respond to him, so build an advantage with lane priority and early jungle invades.
Warwick.teamfight: Enter the backline with Ekko E Phase Dive after Warwick’s engage and crowd control are down and your team has started the fight. Before going in, set up a safe return position with Ekko R Chronobreak. Account for the long leap range of Warwick R Infinite Duress when his movement speed is increased, and watch bushes where you have no vision and areas beyond walls as well.

XinZhao.watch: Dodge the later thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. Avoiding it prevents Challenge and the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If you’ve been hit twice by the empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, use Ekko E Phase Dive to create distance before the third hit knocks you up.
XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Since his damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, reducing his attack speed is also effective. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard deals damage based on current health, so avoid focusing heavily on health alone.
XinZhao.fight: Bait out Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, then start the fight by placing Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of his path. Trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with the outbound and return hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and an empowered attack from Ekko E Phase Dive, then use the movement speed you gain to create distance. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, wait out its immunity and counterattack when it ends.
XinZhao.laning: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Xin Zhao’s approach, then slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder and look for an angle to enter the sphere. Ekko W Parallel Convergence has a windup, so don’t wait until Xin Zhao is on top of you to cast it. Avoid spamming Ekko Q Timewinder on the wave and running out of mana for a fight.
XinZhao.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Xin Zhao’s direction of travel. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive as it returns to enter the sphere and go for a stun and an empowered attack. Trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with the outbound and return hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and an empowered attack, then use Ekko R Chronobreak to deal damage and escape if needed.
XinZhao.escape: Right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is used is your window to close in with Ekko E Phase Dive. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of time to block Xin Zhao’s escape route. When the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike is coming, use Ekko E Phase Dive to get out of range, and use Ekko R Chronobreak to escape if needed.
XinZhao.phase: Ekko’s jungle clear isn’t especially fast early, so look for gank angles using Ekko W Parallel Convergence. In late-game teamfights, treat the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends as your chance to counterattack.
XinZhao.teamfight: Wait until Xin Zhao’s engage and crowd control are used and your team has started the fight, then enter with Ekko E Phase Dive. Before going in, keep a safe position in mind to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak, and stay spaced from your team so Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback doesn’t split your formation. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, aim to strike when its immunity ends instead of dealing damage from outside his spear range.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his whirlwind is ready, so stay out of range until the stacks disappear. After Yone engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, he can deal extra damage when he returns to his body, so if your health is low, heal or escape with Ekko R Chronobreak before he returns. Yone R Fate Sealed moves behind the last champion in its path, so check your position right before a teamfight.
Yone.fight: Keep your distance while Yone’s whirlwind Q is ready, and engage after Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed are both no longer available. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with an empowered attack from Ekko E Phase Dive and the outbound and return hits of Q. Use the passive’s movement speed to end the trade and get away.
Yone.laning: However, if Yone stacks Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to ready his whirlwind, keep your distance until the stacks disappear. Spamming Ekko Q Timewinder to clear the wave can leave you short on mana for a fight.
Yone.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Yone’s approach or escape route. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the sphere, stun him, and land an empowered attack.
Yone.escape: Look to engage after Yone’s whirlwind Q disappears and Yone E Soul Unbound is no longer available. If Yone R Fate Sealed is still on cooldown, close the distance with Ekko E Phase Dive and block his escape route with the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence. If only one of Yone’s mobility abilities is down, he can escape with the other, so don’t chase too far.
Yone.phase: If it’s difficult to start a teamfight, clear waves with Ekko Q Timewinder and pressure from a side lane.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield doesn’t grow, and check whether you’re standing furthest back along Yone R Fate Sealed’s path. Wait until Yone’s engage and crowd control are used and your team has started the fight, then enter the enemy backline. Before going in, set up a safe position to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak, and look to stun Yone with Ekko W Parallel Convergence when he enters with Yone E Soul Unbound.

Zed.watch: Watch out for the damage sequence from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark. Check the shadow’s position and move outside the slow from Zed E Shadow Slash. If Zed R Death Mark marks you, interrupt Zed’s follow-up attacks, and use Ekko R Chronobreak’s damage immunity when the mark detonates.
Zed.fight: Look for an opening after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, when the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already switched positions. Ekko’s main magic damage is effective against Zed, whose magic resistance is relatively low, so trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with the outbound and return hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and an empowered attack from Ekko E Phase Dive, then use the movement speed to get away.
Zed.laning: Avoid giving Zed an early advantage, and watch Zed W Living Shadow’s position to dodge the slow. Use Ekko Q Timewinder to poke or clear the wave, but don’t spam it and run out of mana for a fight. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Zed’s escape route, slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then go in with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Zed.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Zed’s path to give it time to set up. Slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive as Timewinder returns to enter the sphere and chain a stun into an empowered attack. Trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and an empowered attack.
Zed.escape: Look for an opening right after Zed W Living Shadow is down, but check whether Zed can still escape with Zed R Death Mark. In particular, while Zed R Death Mark is still on cooldown, close the distance with Ekko E Phase Dive and block his escape route with Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Check Zed’s shadow position and dodge the slow from Zed E Shadow Slash before going in.
Zed.phase: Be careful not to give Zed an early advantage. Zed peaks in the mid game, so reduce your chances of getting caught alone and stick with your team. Zed gets weaker later while Ekko is strong in the mid to late game, so pressure a side lane when there’s no good opportunity to start a teamfight.
Zed.teamfight: Wait until your allies have started the fight and Zed’s engage and crowd control have been used, then enter the enemy backline. Before going in, set up a safe position to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak. If Zed goes in with Zed R Death Mark, interrupt his attacks that build up damage with a stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence. If you’re in danger before the mark detonates, avoid the damage and escape with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Zed.build: Zed’s main damage is physical, so build armor first from the early game. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so armor alone won’t stop it; be careful about choosing items that only add a lot of health.

Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot has a visible charge-up, and knocks you up on landing. If you see him charging from behind a wall, avoid the landing spot and look for an angle to interrupt the charge with a stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence placed ahead of time. Once he’s on top of you, watch out for the slow and knockup from Zac Q Stretching Strikes and the maximum-health-based damage from Zac W Unstable Matter.
Zac.build: Build movement speed first so you can get out of Zac’s telegraphed engage spot. If you need to withstand his damage, build magic resistance. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on maximum health, so think carefully before building health alone.
Zac.fight: Right after Zac uses Zac E Elastic Slingshot is your chance to close the distance. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Zac’s path, slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder, then go in with Ekko E Phase Dive. Trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance with the outbound and return hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and an empowered attack, then use the movement speed to create distance. Walk over the chunks Zac leaves behind to destroy them.
Zac.laning: When you see Zac E Elastic Slingshot’s approach path, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of time and look for a stun. To attack, slow Zac with Ekko Q Timewinder, then close in with Ekko E Phase Dive, but don’t spam Ekko Q Timewinder and run short on mana for a fight. If there’s no good opportunity to start a teamfight, clear the lane with Ekko Q Timewinder and pressure a side lane.
Zac.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of Zac’s direction of travel and slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder. Use Ekko R Chronobreak to heal and escape when needed.
Zac.escape: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is used is your window to go in with Ekko E Phase Dive. If Zac Q Stretching Strikes’ crowd control is also down, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead of time and look for an opportunity to engage. Use the movement speed from Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance or Ekko R Chronobreak to get away.
Zac.phase: The available information isn’t enough to determine which side is stronger early. Before fighting over an objective, check whether Zac P Cell Division’s revival is still available.
Zac.teamfight: After absorbing Zac E Elastic Slingshot’s engage and crowd control, create distance to avoid the close-range damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. Instead of diving in first, wait until your allies start the fight, then place Ekko W Parallel Convergence along the enemy’s path and enter the enemy backline.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you’ll fall asleep after a short delay, making Zoe Q Paddle Star! easy to land. Dodge the bubble; if it hits, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep triggers to get out of Zoe Q’s angle and range. A missed bubble remains as a trap, so watch narrow paths and brush entrances without vision.
Zoe.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Zoe’s main damage. However, Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble reduces magic resistance and also deals true damage, so consider movement speed to dodge it and health to withstand the damage.
Zoe.fight: Once Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive for a short trade. Land both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and Ekko E’s empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed you gain to disengage.
Zoe.laning: Use Ekko Q Timewinder to clear the wave while dodging Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, but save enough mana to fight. Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on Zoe’s retreat path, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the sphere as Q slows her.
Zoe.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead in Zoe’s path, then slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder and use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the sphere and stun her. Follow with an empowered attack and Q’s returning hit to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. If Zoe R Portal Jump appears, aim W and Q at the spot where she started, where she will return.
Zoe.escape: The moment Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble goes down is your chance to engage with Ekko E Phase Dive. You can also close the gap while Zoe R Portal Jump is down; before going in, keep in mind where Ekko R Chronobreak will return you.
Zoe.phase: In the mid and late game, as ability power builds, Ekko’s damage, Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s shield, and R’s healing all become stronger.
Zoe.teamfight: Engage on Zoe after the enemy’s engage and crowd control abilities are down and your team has started the fight. When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble goes down, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on her path and close in with Ekko E Phase Dive. Before engaging, set up a safe return point with Ekko R Chronobreak.

Belveth.watch: Being knocked up by Bel'Veth W Above and Below also resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, so when she closes in, dodge by turning sideways instead of retreating in a straight line. While Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, don’t commit the damage from Ekko Q Timewinder and Ekko E Phase Dive; wait for it to end or interrupt it with Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun.
Belveth.build: Build armor first against Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Resistance cannot block the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, so also build health and consider effects that reduce her attack speed to limit basic attacks you take.
Belveth.fight: Immediately after Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down and you’ve dodged Bel'Veth W Above and Below, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in advance to set up an engage. After Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends, land both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and Ekko E Phase Dive’s empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed you gain to disengage.
Belveth.laning: Pressure Bel'Veth in early encounters, before she has built stacks, and steal camps and large monsters to slow her growth. When ganking, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on her escape route, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then engage with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Belveth.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead in Bel'Veth’s path, slow her with Ekko Q Timewinder, then use Ekko E Phase Dive to enter the sphere, stun her, and land an empowered attack. For a quick burst, close in with Ekko E Phase Dive as Ekko Q Timewinder returns, landing both hits and an empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance. If Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, delay your damage until its cast ends.
Belveth.phase: In the mid and late game, don’t assume you can catch Bel'Veth with the same setup; choose fights after her mobility and crowd control are down.
Belveth.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Go in after the enemy’s engage and crowd control abilities, such as Bel'Veth W Above and Below, are down and your team has started the fight. Before engaging, keep a safe return point in mind with Ekko R Chronobreak, and save your main damage while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active. If an ally dies and leaves a Void Coral, retreat before Bel'Veth picks it up, and delay the team fight while Bel'Veth’s transformation is active.
Belveth.escape: After Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down, if you also dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, go in with the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence before Q comes back up. Bel'Veth can't immediately dash again in the same direction as her most recent dash, so use that axis to choose your Ekko E Phase Dive engage and escape directions.

Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, his next Q becomes a tornado that knocks you up. When you see the stack indicator, move out of its line and dodge sideways. Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks projectiles, so check its position when you cast Ekko Q Timewinder.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first because Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath deal his main physical damage. Also keep in mind that armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: Break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first with light poke, then start trading. When Yasuo throws his tornado and his Q Steel Tempest stacks reset, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on the engage path and go in with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Yasuo.combo: Avoid Yasuo W Wind Wall, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead in Yasuo’s path, then slow him with Ekko Q Timewinder. If needed, return with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo throws his tornado and his Q Steel Tempest stacks reset is your chance to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can still be used again, so don’t go in just because he has used one mobility ability; look for an opening with Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up.
Yasuo.phase: Ekko’s jungle clear is not especially fast early on, but you can look for ganks using Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun. The available information isn’t enough to say for certain which of Yasuo or Ekko is stronger at each stage.
Yasuo.teamfight: Enter the enemy backline after Yasuo’s engage and crowd control abilities are down and your team has started the fight. Before going in, establish a safe position to return to with Ekko R Chronobreak, and place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on the enemy’s path.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin on your side to reduce the minions Yasuo can dash to with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When Yasuo approaches, dodge the narrow hitbox of Q Steel Tempest to the side, and use Ekko Q Timewinder while saving mana for the fight.

Nocturne.watch: When Nocturne R Paranoia is active, don’t get isolated; immediately move toward your allies. Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror only fears you if its tether remains connected, so use Ekko E Phase Dive to create distance when Nocturne casts E. If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, turn toward your allies or a turret instead of fleeing in a straight line along its trail.
Nocturne.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Q Duskbringer, and R Paranoia. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nocturne.fight: While Nocturne R Paranoia is down, close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive to start a fight. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is still available, remove it first with Ekko Q Timewinder, then look for a stun with Ekko W Parallel Convergence placed in advance. Land both hits of Ekko Q Timewinder and Ekko E’s empowered attack to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, then use the movement speed you gain to disengage.
Nocturne.laning: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, move at an angle toward your allies or a turret until its trail disappears. Before Nocturne R Paranoia becomes available and after he uses it, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on his engage or escape path, then follow with Q’s slow and E’s engage. Spamming Ekko Q Timewinder to clear waves can leave you short on mana to fight.
Nocturne.combo: Place Ekko W Parallel Convergence ahead on Nocturne’s path. Time Ekko E’s empowered attack with Q’s return to trigger Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance, and return with Ekko R Chronobreak if needed.
Nocturne.phase: Ekko’s jungle clear is not especially fast early on, but you have a chance to catch Nocturne before Nocturne R Paranoia becomes available. When Nocturne R is ready, watch your distance from your allies so you aren’t caught while pressuring alone.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, immediately move toward your allies to avoid being caught alone. After Nocturne’s engage and crowd control abilities are down and your team has started the fight, place Ekko W Parallel Convergence in advance and enter the back line. Before going in, set up a safe return point with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Nocturne.escape: The window for Ekko to go in is when Nocturne R Paranoia is down or he has not unlocked it yet. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is still available, approach carefully so you can use Ekko E Phase Dive to break the fear tether. Once Nocturne E is down, place W Parallel Convergence in advance and close the distance with E.
